headline: Japan Makes a Gambit Amid “Middle East Naphtha Shock”: Growing Waste Plastic into a “Resource”
summary: The Japanese government will develop waste plastic as a domestic resource to replace naphtha, a petrochemical feedstock. Deteriorating Middle East conditions have exposed the vulnerability of the naphtha supply chain.
why: Naphtha is a petroleum-derived feedstock used to make plastics and chemicals, and Japan relies heavily on imports. Supply disruptions in the Middle East, a major crude and naphtha exporter, affect Asian petrochemical costs.
